notes.title: HOTFIX(MAR 12)
notes.notes:
Thank you for the support! We did some minor changes to the game.
[list]
[*] changed the QTE speed, now you have more time to read the options
[*] enabled skipping and rollback - now you can press Ctrl to skip and use mousewheel to rollback
[*] some translation typos
[*] fixed some bugs that may prevent players from finishing the game
[/list]

notes.title: Dragon Island is officially launching!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41438024/80d9a011c709040391d204b2af767d4640cec791.png[/img]
Dragon Island has officially launched, thanks for the support and waiting!
Attention passengers, the cruise ship to Dragon Island is departing soon, please board the ship and be seated. We hope you spend a wonderful time on the island, enjoy the sunny beach and hot spring here! 
The game’s main storyline is now full and playable. In the future, we plan to optimize the English translation, and complete the supporter contents, such as phone avatars and posts in protagonist’s phone.

notes.title: Dragon Island Demo Released!
notes.notes:
Long wait everyone! The [i]Dragon Island demo[/i] has been released.
Compared to the previous beta version, the public demo version has the following changes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41438024/982c2a4e0b5b4ea66950b0128eeab853b9c2e77e.png[/img]
⚪Improved character stand-ups
⚪New 20+ background music
⚪ You can now explore the villa on the island and interact with other dragons
⚪ You can use Henry's phone now. No internet access, but it's still useful...... right?
